title: GCP Filestore Configuration
description: Environment variables to configure GCP Filestore instances

GCP_PROJECT_ID.description: Google Cloud Platform project ID for Filestore instance provisioning.

FILESTORE_ZONE.description: Google Cloud zone where the Filestore instance is deployed.

FILESTORE_TIER.description: Service tier for Filestore instance performance and storage capacity.

FILESTORE_CAPACITY_GB.description: Allocated storage capacity for the Filestore volume in gigabytes.

FILESTORE_NETWORK.description: VPC network name connected to the Filestore instance.
